description: This file contains functions and types for extracting and managing attribute data related to teams and users, including querying attribute assignments, building lookup maps, and extracting attribute IDs from query values.

methods.name: extractAttributeIdsFromQueryValue
methods.description: Extracts attribute IDs from a query value object, traversing nested rules.

methods.name: _findMembershipsForBothOrgAndTeam
methods.description: Fetches memberships for both organization and team, categorizing them accordingly.

methods.name: _prepareAssignmentData
methods.description: Prepares attribute assignment data for team members, including transforming 'contains' options.

methods.name: _buildAttributeLookupMaps
methods.description: Builds lookup maps for attributes and options for quick access.

methods.name: _getAttributeFromAttributeOption
methods.description: Retrieves attribute info from attribute option ID using lookup maps.

methods.name: _getAttributeOptionFromId
methods.description: Retrieves attribute option details from option ID using lookup maps.

methods.name: _getOrgMembershipToUserIdForTeam
methods.description: Maps organization membership IDs to user IDs for team members.

methods.name: _queryAllData
methods.description: Fetches all relevant attribute and membership data for a given org and team.

methods.name: getAttributesAssignedToMembersOfTeam
methods.description: Retrieves attribute options assigned to team members, optionally filtered by user ID.

methods.name: getAttributesAssignmentData
methods.description: Main function to gather attribute data and assignments for a team within an organization.

methods.name: getAttributesForTeam
methods.description: Fetches attribute data for a specific team.

methods.name: getUsersAttributes
methods.description: Fetches attribute data for a specific user within a team.
